test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the italicized word.**

We also must do something about our mental and physical *lethargy.*
solution:
The correct answer is Hebetude.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'lethargy' means 'a lack of energy and enthusiasm'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Eagerness- Enthusiasm to do or to have something; keenness.
 
• Enthusiasm- Intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
• Hebetude- The state of being dull or lethargic.
 
• Vigor- Physical strength and good health.
 
 
 
• Hence, the appropriate word to replace the word 'lethargy' is 'hebetude'.
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.
